item.title: Unable to Redeem Digital Gift Cards - Roblox
item.description: Digital and Physical Gift Cards that redeem for Roblox Credit (like the majority of cards sold at retailers like Walmart, Target, etc) are now only redeemable by users when their country matches the currency of the gift card. Example: US users redeeming USD, European Union users redeeming EUR, etc. US users will NOT be able to redeem EUR.
